name: mdwrk

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @mdwrk/ui-tokens && npm run build -w @mdwrk/icons && npm run build -w @mdwrk/testing
scripts.build:shared: npm run build:editor && npm run build -w @mdwrk/core-demo-themes && npm run build -w @mdwrk/core-demo-react
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-core && npm run build -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-react
scripts.build:editor: npm run build:renderer && npm run build -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-core && npm run build -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-react && npm run build -w @mdwrk/markdown-edit-in-renderer-react
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-renderer-basic && npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-editor-basic && npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-editor-demo && npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-previewer-demo && npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-edit-in-renderer-demo && npm run build -w @mdwrk/example-ui-tokens-demo
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:editor && npm run test:examples
scripts.test:shared: npm run test -w @mdwrk/ui-tokens && npm run test -w @mdwrk/icons && npm run test -w @mdwrk/testing
scripts.test:renderer: npm run test -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-core && npm run test -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-react
scripts.test:editor: npm run test -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-core && npm run test -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-react && npm run test -w @mdwrk/markdown-edit-in-renderer-react
scripts.test:examples: npm run test -w @mdwrk/example-renderer-basic && npm run test -w @mdwrk/example-editor-demo && npm run test -w @mdwrk/example-previewer-demo && npm run test -w @mdwrk/example-edit-in-renderer-demo && npm run test -w @mdwrk/example-ui-tokens-demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:editor && npm run typecheck:examples
scripts.typecheck:shared: npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/ui-tokens && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/core-demo-themes && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/core-demo-react && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/icons && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/testing
scripts.typecheck:renderer: npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-core && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/markdown-renderer-react
scripts.typecheck:editor: npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-core && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/markdown-editor-react && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/markdown-edit-in-renderer-react
scripts.typecheck:examples: npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-renderer-basic && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-editor-basic && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-editor-demo && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-previewer-demo && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-edit-in-renderer-demo && npm run typecheck -w @mdwrk/example-ui-tokens-demo
scripts.ci:governance: npm run validate:mdwrk-package-cr-order && npm run validate:mdwrk-docs-governance && npm run validate:markdown-command-export-screenshot-manifest

description: MdWrk core renderer, editor, token, icon, testing, and example packages.
author: Jacob Stewart <jacob@swarmauri.com>
